_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 008 (FR-P0-07 read half) — seed row for the dataverse.describe read tool. GA-MCP-contract-frozen per ADR-039: sprk_toolid local segment equals the GA Dataverse MCP tool name 'describe' (research note notes/audit-inputs/research-dataverse-mcp-2026-07.md; Learn ms.date 2026-06-05). Argument shape mirrors GA describe(path, scope?).
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to DataverseDescribeHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered by ToolFrameworkExtensions.AddToolHandlersFromAssembly (ADR-010). The P2 agent loop projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid ('dataverse.describe'); sprk_name keeps the SYS- display convention required by the seed script's safety filter.
_comment_obo: spec MUST rule (task-012 audit): execution goes exclusively through IDataverseUserClient — the caller's bearer token OBO-exchanged for the Dataverse resource. Results respect the calling user's security roles + row-level security. NO app-only Dataverse path is reachable from the handler.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000000 (Read) — drives the ONE confirmation gate (ADR-039): read tools never require confirmation. The handler is structurally read-only (GET-only paths).
_comment_scope_deviation: GA MCP 'describe' also serves skills/ and scopes/ paths (Business Skills — an MCP-server feature). The native transport returns a structured error for those segments; a future transport swap (task-010 spike) gains them with no contract change. 'scope' argument is accepted-but-unfiltered with a warning.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
sprk_description: Describes Dataverse structure and records under the calling user's permissions (read-only). Path forms: 'tables/' lists all tables; 'tables/{logicalName}' returns the table schema with column logical names and types; 'tables/{logicalName}/records/{guid}' returns one full record. Use this FIRST to discover table and column logical names before calling dataverse.read_query, and to read full record details for paths returned by dataverse.search_data. Results respect the current user's Dataverse security roles and row-level security.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — dataverse.* tools exist for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: dataverse.describe Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape frozen against the GA Dataverse MCP describe(path, scope?) tool.

path.description: Filesystem-style describe path: 'tables/' (list tables), 'tables/{logicalName}' (table schema), or 'tables/{logicalName}/records/{guid}' (full record).

scope.description: Optional scope filter (GA MCP compatibility). Not implemented by the native transport — acknowledged with a warning; result is unfiltered.

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — single LLM-facing function. Reserved for per-environment defaults (e.g. table-list cap).
